name: AeroPress (Standard Method)
summary: Fast, portable, and clean — a hybrid of immersion and pressure filtration.

steps.title: Set up
steps.instruction: Rinse the paper filter in the cap, attach it, and set the AeroPress upright on your mug.

steps.title: Add coffee
steps.instruction: Add 17g of medium-ground coffee into the chamber.

steps.title: Pour and stir
steps.instruction: Pour in 250ml of water, then stir gently for about 10 seconds to saturate evenly.

steps.title: Steep
steps.instruction: Insert the plunger slightly to seal without pressing, and let the coffee steep.

steps.title: Press
steps.instruction: Press down slowly and steadily until you hear a hiss, which signals you're done.
steps.tip: Press gently — forcing it can push grit through the filter.
